statements:
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
  "name" VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  email CITEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  referrer_id UUID,
  CONSTRAINT customer_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key UNIQUE (email)
)
COMMENT ON TABLE customer IS 'A customer of the shop.'
steps.subject: table/customer

statements:
CREATE TABLE label (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
  "name" CITEXT NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT label_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT label_name_key UNIQUE ("name")
)
COMMENT ON TABLE label IS 'A label an order can carry.'
steps.subject: table/label

statements:
CREATE TABLE "order" (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
  code VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  customer_id UUID NOT NULL,
  total BIGINT NOT NULL,
  reference TEXT,
  note TEXT,
  placed_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT order_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
COMMENT ON TABLE "order" IS 'An order a customer placed.'
steps.subject: table/order

statements:
CREATE TABLE order_label (
  order_id UUID NOT NULL,
  label_id UUID NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT order_label_pkey PRIMARY KEY (order_id, label_id)
)
COMMENT ON TABLE order_label IS 'Join table for order.labels'
steps.subject: table/order_label

statements:
CREATE TABLE order_line (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
  sku TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity BIGINT NOT NULL,
  order_id UUID NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT order_line_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
COMMENT ON TABLE order_line IS 'One line of an order.'
steps.subject: table/order_line

statements:
CREATE TABLE product (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL,
  price BIGINT NOT NULL,
  search_text TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (COALESCE(title, '')) STORED,
  CONSTRAINT product_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
COMMENT ON TABLE product IS 'A product in the catalog, searchable by title.'
steps.subject: table/product

statements:
CREATE VIEW report.order_summary WITH (security_barrier = true) AS
-- Projection column order is the published Arrow contract.
SELECT -- noqa: ST06
  base.code,
  base.total,
  customer."name" AS customer_name
FROM "order" AS base
  INNER JOIN customer AS customer ON base.customer_id = customer.id
COMMENT ON VIEW report.order_summary IS 'Orders with their customer''s name, for reporting.'
steps.subject: view/report.order_summary
